Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 30 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 37 dollars and 7 days per identity before it can vote at all.
